name: selected-project-read
goal: Keep the currently selected project readable during active runs while refusing a switch to another project

evidence: Opening Game Views reselects the current project. Active or pending agent work should allow that read, while switching to another project stays blocked.

Existing project-operation ownership tests cover stale identity but not idempotent selection during busy or pending work. Extend the same two-project lifecycle and preserve refusal of cross-project switches.
